capabilities: Mark Canvas edges as explicit parent-child relations
Move a node together with all of its descendants
Collapse and expand descendants by branch direction
Focus on a selected node with its ancestors and siblings
Copy a node with its downstream branch and edges
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later with the built-in Canvas core plugin enabled; fully local, no telemetry; optional Markdown state note for syncing hierarchy across devices.
intentEvidence: adds explicit hierarchy, branch movement, focused editing, and descendant collapse tools to Obsidian Canvas
problem: Obsidian Canvas treats nodes as flat spatial cards with no persistent parent-child structure, so you cannot move, collapse, focus, or copy a node together with its descendants.
summary: Canvas tool that adds explicit parent-child hierarchy, branch movement, focus mode, and descendant collapse to Obsidian Canvas files.
